# Specifications

Specifications define observable behavior and authorization before
implementation. They are not implementation narratives.

## Required sections

- Objective and user value.
- In-scope and out-of-scope behavior.
- Constraints and invariants.
- Acceptance criteria with evidence.
- Platform impact.
- Compatibility, migration, rollout, and rollback.
- Security, privacy, and observability.
- Open decisions and assumptions.

## Lifecycle

`draft -> review -> approved -> implementing -> verified -> superseded`

Material changes after approval require a recorded revision and renewed review.
Do not silently rewrite acceptance criteria to match an implementation.
